key_insight: In finite systems, the capillary-wave energy-cascade spectrum has a limited dynamic range that shrinks with decreasing nonlinearity, scaling with average steepness as ∼μ^(8/3).
engineering_relevance: Finite-domain capillary-wave simulations must account for wave steepness when assessing whether an energy-cascade spectrum can be resolved.
method: Numerically simulate capillary-wave turbulence in finite systems.
Test the dynamic-range scaling of the Zakharov–Filonenko spectrum.
evidence_signal: The simulations confirm the proposed ∼μ^(8/3) scaling and report spectral dynamic ranges close to or exceeding one decade across multiple configurations.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical-resolution or uncertainty details, limiting assessment of the scaling's robustness.
paper_title: Wave Turbulence of Capillary Waves in Finite Systems
